title: Script element inside the SVG
basis: OWASP: an SVG served from your own origin executes its script in your origin.
fix: Delete the script element. Behaviour belongs in your bundle, not in an asset.

title: Inline event handler attribute
basis: onload/onclick/onerror in SVG run on render and survive most naive sanitizers.
fix: Remove the on* attribute and bind the handler in code.

title: javascript: URI
basis: A javascript: href inside an anchor or use element is a same-origin execution path.
fix: Point the link at a real URL, or drop the anchor.

title: Reference to a third-party server
basis: EDPB/German case law on embedded third-party assets: the visitor's IP reaches that server before any consent banner.
fix: Self-host the referenced file and use a relative path.

title: Remote font pulled from inside the SVG
basis: LG Munchen I, 20 Jan 2022 (3 O 17493/20) awarded EUR 100 for one embedded Google font.
fix: Self-host the font file and reference it relatively, or use a system font stack.

title: foreignObject carries HTML into the SVG
basis: foreignObject is the standard bypass for SVG sanitizers that only allow-list SVG tags.
fix: Render that HTML outside the SVG, or strip the node before shipping.

title: No accessible name and not marked decorative
basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1 / EN 301 549 clause 9.1.1.1: non-text content needs a text alternative or must be hidden.
fix: Add a title element as the first child, or aria-hidden="true" if it is decorative.

title: Empty title element
basis: An empty title is an announced blank: worse than no title, because it suppresses the fallback.
fix: Write what the icon means, not what it looks like.

title: Design-tool placeholder used as the name
basis: Layer 1, Artboard, Group, Vector, Frame 42 are export artefacts, not text alternatives.
fix: Replace it with the action or meaning the icon carries.

title: Named SVG without role="img"
basis: Without role="img" several screen reader and browser pairs skip the title entirely.
fix: Add role="img" to the root svg element.

title: No viewBox on the root element
basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4/1.4.10: a fixed-size SVG will not scale with text or reflow.
fix: Add viewBox="0 0 W H" matching the export size.

title: Base64 raster embedded in a vector file
basis: The bitmap keeps its own pixels and loses any alt text the original img element had.
fix: Ship the raster as its own file with an img element and an alt attribute.

title: Editor metadata names a person or a machine
basis: GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation: dc:creator and document paths ship the author's name and folder layout.
fix: Run the file through an SVG optimiser that strips metadata before committing.

title: Duplicate id in the same file
basis: Once inlined, duplicate ids break clipPath, gradient and aria-labelledby lookups.
fix: Prefix ids per asset or let your build tool namespace them.
